sbc_once.principle: Employee stock compensation is a real cost and must be charged exactly once, whether the bridge starts from net income or operating cash flow.
sbc_once.rule: On the NI+D&A bridge remove the second subtraction of stock compensation; on the OCF bridge retain the SBC subtraction. Retain maintenance investment, leases, parent allocation, dilution and SBC/OCF accounting checks. Bridge disclosure charges zero additional SBC when it is already in NI, and explicitly names that basis.

current_scale.principle: For an established high-return business, normalize profitability through the cycle at the business's current scale instead of treating its smaller past size as a permanent earnings ceiling.
current_scale.rule: For v2 operating companies with all five quality tests passing, at least eight finite ten-year ROIC observations with median >=20%, and at least eight finite owner-earnings returns on total capital with median >=15%, require five complete consecutive positive owner-earnings observations with positive finite revenue. Normalize with median of those five owner-earnings/revenue margins multiplied by latest annual revenue, still capped by latest annual OE and available complete newer TTM OE. Otherwise retain min(5y median dollar OE, latest, TTM). Scale the median-margin observation's bridge components by latest revenue / that observation's revenue so the bridge exactly reconciles. Apply existing financing adjustment after selection. Raw variability and commodity classification continue to determine compounder exclusion and MOS; this normalization does not confer compounder status. Current sales are annual, never an optimistic extrapolation of TTM growth.
current_scale.parameters: Existing five-year normalization window, eight-observation minimum and 20%/15% capital-return hurdles. Median normal profitability times current scale is an accounting dimensional identity. No new return-fitted cutoffs.

combined.principle: A correct expense basis and a current business scale should be evaluated together only when each individually passes.
combined.rule: Both candidates together; cannot rescue a rejected component.

presentation: Show the five-year ratio of totals as the decisive cash-conversion measure; annual median and latest are explicitly annual context, chart point labels are annual, and no individual annual row claims to decide the aggregate test. No threshold change.
unchanged: All growth caps/estimates, fade/terminal, discount rate, MOS/leverage thresholds, financial and NAV formulas, .80 economics bar, quality rules other than the SBC numerator's consequences.

ship.loser_dominance: In EACH required scope/period, negative matured three-year total returns must not exceed half of observed NEWLY QUALIFYING BUY company-quarter records. Report missing outcomes, unique company counts, below-median/top-decile counts and unique-company averaged outcomes separately. Zero new buys is vacuous parity. Unobserved buys do not count as successes.
ship.combination: Every component and combined portfolio/new-buy gate must pass. No retuning after evaluation.

Train 2005Q1–2015Q3 ending2015-12-31, later2016Q1–2026Q2 ending2026-09-30. 3y/5y predictive cohorts mature entirely inside split. approval: Zero approved buy changes. List proposals with evidence; production continuity preserves full live records for any unapproved flip. Proposed is not approved.
